title: MM6 female peasant 2
regions: blue short front apron, thin blue waist tie, and small blue cloth head cap only; protect brown overdress, tan blouse sleeves/collar, leather shoes, dark hair, eyes, skin and wooden rolling pin
description: The same middle-aged medieval woman in every pose, sturdy ordinary adult body build, warm fair-to-olive skin, short straight black/dark-brown hair reaching the nape, a small flat folded blue cloth cap resting on top of her head (not a large bonnet). A coarse dark-brown sleeveless square-neck overdress, ankle-length full skirt, over a TAN/OCHRE long-sleeved high-neck blouse with close wrist cuffs. A narrow waist-tied BLUE apron hanging only to around the knees at the FRONT, with a thin blue waist tie continuing across the back; the back skirt remains all brown. Brown low leather shoes, no modern fashion redesign, no jewelry or armor additions. Preserve the native middle-aged face, substantial body proportions, cap silhouette and layered garment construction. In attack poses only, she wields the native wooden rolling pin in her RIGHT hand, following its exact visibility and hand positions; do not add a weapon in other actions.
